Public guidance checked 21 September 2026.

What it is, and isn't

One control plane. Several control surfaces.

Agent 365 coordinates oversight; specialist teams still work in their own services.

What it is

A centralized inventory and oversight layer for Microsoft and integrated third-party agents.

How it works

Microsoft 365 administration connects with Entra, Purview, Defender and endpoint controls.

Why executives care

Assign responsibility and apply consistent guardrails without making every agent its own governance project.

✕

Not one universal console

The Microsoft 365 admin center is the front door, not the home of every investigation, data policy or access control.

✕

Not automatic protection

Coverage depends on integration, licensing, identity use, telemetry and scoped policies.

✕

Not proof of ROI or compliance

Activity is evidence of use. Outcomes and regulatory obligations need separate evaluation.

Lifecycle governance · Microsoft 365 admin center

Approve with guardrails. Retire deliberately.

WhereAll Agents → Requests · Settings → Templates
Control entry & lifecycleReview requests; deploy, assign, block or delete. Conditions-based rules support estate hygiene.
Reuse guardrailsTemplates reference Entra, Purview, SharePoint and Defender policies for new activations.
Business value: more repeatable approvals and fewer orphaned agents.

Important: template edits don't retroactively update approved agents. Scenario availability varies; verify the tenant.

Access control · Microsoft Entra

Bound access across the agent lifecycle

🔑

Grant only what's needed

Agent identity → Permissions · Entitlement management

Access packages bundle allowed resources and roles. Distinguish delegated user context from autonomous agent access.

🔄

Keep accountability current

Identity Governance → Lifecycle workflows

Use sponsor lifecycle handling and reassignment when accountable people leave or change roles.

⚡

Condition access on risk

Conditional Access / ID Protection

Apply agent-appropriate risk-based controls. Don't treat an agent as a human answering an MFA prompt.

Enforcement boundary: assigning an Entra policy isn't enough. The agent must authenticate with Entra on actual resource access for Entra controls to apply.
Business value: reduce excess privilege and unmanaged access that outlives the business purpose.
Data security · Microsoft Purview

Protect the data, not just the identity

WherePurview → DSPM → AI observability
See activity & data riskActive agents, activities, risks and recommendations in the new DSPM experience.
Apply scoped protectionDLP can block or audit supported human–agent interactions in Teams, email, SharePoint and OneDrive.
No automatic inheritance: new Agent 365 content doesn't inherit source sensitivity labels or encryption.

Compliance operations · Microsoft Purview

Preserve evidence. Support obligations.

Understand & assess
Audit / Compliance Manager

Audit, sensitive-data classification and AI Compliance Manager assessments are automatically on for Agent 365 instances. Other policies need scoping.

On by default
Investigate conduct
Insider Risk / Comm. Compliance / eDiscovery

Apply supported risk and communication policies. Preserve, search and export supported human–agent interactions.

Scope required
Manage content over time
Data Lifecycle Management

Use supported retention and deletion controls. Confirm what each policy covers before relying on it.

Scope required
Business value: defensible evidence and repeatable processes, not an automatic compliance guarantee.

Encrypted sources: agents need explicit file sharing and VIEW/EXTRACT rights for labeled, encrypted files. eDiscovery coverage isn't a promise that every agent trace is captured.

Threat detection · Microsoft Defender

Connect agent risk to the security operation

WhereAssets → AI agents · Hunting → Advanced hunting
Triage with contextRisk, recommendations, alerts, tools, identity and relationships together for supported agents.
Investigate behaviorPublic preview Suspicious behavior alerts, incident context and hunting over agent observability.
Business value: faster, better-informed investigations.

Connectors and telemetry are required. Foundry support covers published agents, not playground-only agents. Runtime protection covers supported paths, not every tool call.

Govern the tools agents can use

WhereAgents → Tools → Registry / Requests

Risk-to-response journey

An illustrative risk-to-response journey

🤖
1
Discover
Microsoft 365 → All Agents

An ownerless agent appears in the inventory. The platform team assigns accountability.

2
Bound access
Entra → Agent identity

Owners inspect permissions; the sponsor confirms purpose and resources.

3
Review data risk
Purview → AI observability

The data team checks sensitive-data activity and adjusts scoped protection.

4
Investigate & act
Defender → AI agents / hunting

The SOC correlates signals. Admins choose a supported block or remediation.

CSO outcome

Clear handoffs, bounded exposure and evidence for investigation.

CTO outcome

Reusable controls and a safer route from experimentation to operations.

Operating model example, not an automated end-to-end product promise. Rehearse this journey with a low-risk pilot; integration, policy scope and telemetry determine which steps work for each agent.

Licensing

License the control plane. Verify each capability.

Baseline Microsoft 365

Registry; basic deploy, approve, block, delete, assign, reassign and pin; conditions-based lifecycle rules; external registry sync.

Agent 365 / Microsoft 365 E7 premium

Policy templates, activity visualization, tenant-wide tools controls and extended Entra, Purview, Defender and Intune capabilities.

1 May 2026Agent 365 commercially GA, per user. Needs at least one qualifying license; standalone with eligible Microsoft 365, or included in E7.
1 July 2026Specified Copilot Studio / Foundry agent-level Defender security requires eligible Agent 365 licensing.
GA ≠ everything is GA. Preview: specific-agent map, Defender detection/protection, endpoint runtime, BYO remote MCP.
Check the entitlement. An existing E5 license alone is not Agent 365 entitlement.
Rollout gates

Make the first rollout measurable

01
Platform + identity

Establish coverage

Inventory the pilot, name owners and sponsors, and confirm licensing, connected platforms and Entra resource authentication.

Measure: owner coverage, estate coverage, excess permissions
02
Data security + SOC

Prove controls

Scope policies and test allowed and blocked access. Connect Defender at Settings → Security for AI → Get started.

Measure: policy coverage, telemetry, triage time
03
Business sponsor

Demonstrate value

Compare a real workflow against a pre-pilot baseline; verify quality and human oversight before expanding.

Measure: cycle time, quality, rework, cost per task
Scale only when ownership, protection and a business outcome are demonstrated together.

Recommended launch gates, not claimed results or promised ROI. Use 30-day activity as an adoption indicator, not ROI. Set targets after the baseline.
